text:
As a secret shopper this is terrible for the business and a coworker for the BBB you guys messed up big time. The overall ranking will be lowered extremely. Horrible mistake. Yall sounded and looked silly. This job is y'all's exact level of education. Imagine being a mad employee at McDonalds thats embarrassing.

I have never experienced customer service this bad in my life—at ANY McDonald’s, anywhere. I came through the drive-thru for a DoorDash pickup and it turned into the most ridiculous, chaotic mess I’ve ever seen.

First, the employee at the window didn’t give me my order… because it wasn’t even READY. Then when they finally handed me a bag, it was completely the WRONG order—like not even close. When I politely told them it wasn’t mine, the employee acted like I was trying to steal food I didn’t even want. The attitude was unbelievable. Eye-rolling, huffing, talking under their breath… the whole thing felt like a bad comedy skit.

They said they were going to cancel the order so I could move on, but of course… they didn’t. Instead they just stood there arguing and holding up the window like everyone else’s time didn’t matter. They kept the entire drive-thru line frozen for over 10 minutes with cars wrapping around the building. People behind me were literally sticking their heads out of their windows wondering what on EARTH was going on.

I’ve never seen a line move that slow at ANY fast-food place. It was beyond frustrating—it was horrendous, outrageous, and honestly embarrassing for the store. If this is the level of customer service they think is acceptable, I can’t imagine how they stay open.

Absolutely the worst experience I’ve ever had. Avoid this location if you value your time, your sanity, or even just basic human respect.
author: Erika Gonzales

text: The male staff by the window accepting payment for orders was very rude. After waiting I thought maybe I'll have to pay in the second window since this no one is assisting us in the first one. How would I know right? If you have long line you should pay attention to who is in your window. so I moved pass the first window but not too far yet, since the line was so long. The staff finally open the window and didn't even apologize that they were not even in the window attending to the customer, got upset and told me "you I didn't pay" in a tone like I'm running away. I said I didn't know if I'll pay here bec the window is close and he said they always keep the window close. I handed him my card and instead of apologizing for their mistake, told me I should always stop and pay in that window.. I understand that but to argue with me and told me I should always stop in that window is not nice. It's okay if I moved forward without stopping in the first window waiting for someone to get my payment but none.so  This person is very rude, impolite and needs to learn good customer service. Your shop will not benefit if you have people who are like that. Treat your customer nicely no matter what and don't always assumed that someone is running away without paying their food. text:
